newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan internal aluminium sales up 17.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan internal aluminium sales up 17.2 pct.

text.p: Brazilian total internal sales of primary aluminium reached 17,000 tonnes in January, up 17.2 percent on the 14,500 tonnes sold in January 1996, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
The result exceeded industry expectations of a possible 10 percent growth in the first month of this year.
The key contributing factor to the increase was the positive performance of the car sector which uses a large number of aluminium parts and components.
ABAL said however it did not expect to see a similar growth in February as it is a shorter working month than January.
((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
